WITH pm_role AS ( SELECT r.id AS role_id FROM roles r WHERE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'PM' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ), gm_role AS ( SELECT r.id AS role_id FROM roles r WHERE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'GM' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ), ka_row AS ( SELECT ka.id, ka.cycle_id, ka.created_by FROM kpi_assignments ka WHERE ka.id = #{id} AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.user_id = #{userId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL ), assigner_best AS ( SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = kr.created_by ORDER BY CASE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), 'PM' ) AS best_code FROM ka_row kr ), target_pick AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN ab.best_code = 'GM' THEN gr.role_id ELSE pr.role_id END AS target_role_id FROM assigner_best ab CROSS JOIN pm_role pr CROSS JOIN gm_role gr ), updated_feedback AS ( UPDATE kpi_assignment_feedbacks f SET feedback_note = #{feedbackComment}, target_role_id = tp.target_role_id FROM ka_row k CROSS JOIN target_pick tp WHERE f.assignment_id = k.id AND f.cycle_id = k.cycle_id AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING f.assignment_id ), inserted_feedback AS ( INSERT INTO kpi_assignment_feedbacks ( assignment_id, cycle_id, feedback_note, target_role_id, created_by ) SELECT k.id, k.cycle_id, #{feedbackComment}, tp.target_role_id, #{userId} FROM ka_row k CROSS JOIN target_pick tp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_feedback) RETURNING assignment_id ) UPDATE kpi_assignments ka
status_code = #{statusCode}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE ka.id = #{id} AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.user_id = #{userId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM updated_feedback UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM inserted_feedback )
UPDATE kpi_assignments SET status_code = 501, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status_code = 405
UPDATE kpi_assignments SET status_code = 405, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status_code = 404
UPDATE kpi_assignments SET status_code = 601, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status_code IN (405, 503)

ki.id AS info_id, ki.target_description AS info_target_desc, ki.target_value AS info_target_val, ki.weight AS info_weight, ki.is_important AS info_is_important,

kc.id AS cat_id, kc.name AS cat_name,
child_ka.id AS child_asm_id, child_ka.target_value AS child_asm_target, child_ka.mid_self_score AS child_mid_score, child_ka.end_self_score AS child_end_score, child_ka.end_pm_score AS child_pm_score, child_ka.end_gm_score AS child_end_gm_score, child_ka.status_code AS child_status_code, child_ka.update_reason AS child_update_reason, child_ka.evidences AS child_evidences, child_kf.feedback_note AS child_feedback_note, child_fb_role.target_role_code AS child_feedback_target_role_code,
child_u.id AS child_user_id, COALESCE(child_kas.user_full_name, child_u.full_name) AS child_full_name,
COALESCE(child_kas.job_title_id, child_jt.id) AS child_jt_id, COALESCE(child_kas.job_title_name, child_jt.name) AS child_jt_name
FROM kpi_assignments pm_ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON pm_ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.feedback_note FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f WHERE f.assignment_id = pm_ka.id AND f.cycle_id = pm_ka.cycle_id AND f.target_role_id = ( SELECT r.id FROM roles r WHERE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'GM' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 ) AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pm_kf ON TRUE LEFT JOIN kpi_assignments child_ka ON child_ka.cycle_id = pm_ka.cycle_id AND child_ka.kpi_info_id = pm_ka.kpi_info_id AND child_ka.id != pm_ka.id AND child_ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND child_ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( IS NULL WHERE child_scope.assignment_id = child_ka.id AND child_scope.cycle_id = child_ka.cycle_id AND ( child_scope.supervisor_id = #{pmId} OR child_sd.manager_id = #{pmId} ) ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignment_snapshots child_scope_missing INNER JOIN kpi_cycles child_scope_missing_cycle ON child_scope_missing_cycle.id = child_scope_missing.cycle_id AND NULL AND child_d.manager_id = #{pmId} WHERE child_ud.user_id = child_ka.user_id AND child_ud.is_primary = TRUE ) ) ) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.feedback_note FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f WHERE f.assignment_id = child_ka.id AND f.cycle_id = child_ka.cycle_id AND f.target_role_id = ( SELECT r.id FROM roles r WHERE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'PM' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 ) AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) child_kf ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) AS target_role_code FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = f.target_role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE child_ka.id IS NOT NULL AND f.assignment_id = child_ka.id AND f.cycle_id = child_ka.cycle_id AND kpi_assignment_snapshots child_kas ON child_kas.assignment_id = child_ka.id AND child_kas.cycle_id = child_ka.cycle_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_cycles child_kas_cycle WHERE child_kas_cycle.id = child_kas.cycle_id AND child_kas_cycle.deleted_at IS NULL AND child_kas_cycle.year < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int ) LEFT JOIN job_titles child_jt ON child_u.job_title_id = child_jt.id AND child_jt.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE pm_ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND pm_ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND pm_ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL AND ( pm_ka.user_id = #{pmId} OR pm_ka.department_id IN (SELECT id FROM departments WHERE manager_id = #{pmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL) ) ORDER BY km.code, child_u.full_name

SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ki.id AS kpi_information_id, COALESCE(ka.target_value, ki.target_value) AS target_value, km.unit_code AS unit_code, unit_sc.name AS unit_name, ki.target_description, ka.end_gm_score, ka.evidences, kaf.feedback_note AS feedback_comment, ka.update_reason AS update_reason, ka.created_at AS assignment_created_at, (km.created_by = #{userId}) AS created_by_current_user, creator_role.created_by_role_code AS created_by_role_code, CASE WHEN ka.status_code = 407 THEN 'feedback' WHEN ka.end_pm_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'approved' WHEN (ka.mid_self_score IS NOT NULL OR ka.end_self_score IS NOT NULL OR (ka.evidences IS NOT NULL AND ka.evidences::text NOT IN ('{}', '[]', 'null'))) THEN 'pending_approval' WHEN ka.status_code = 405 AND ( (cyc.mid_year_end IS NOT NULL AND NOW() > cyc.mid_year_end AND (cyc.end_year_start IS NULL OR NOW() < cyc.end_year_start)) OR (cyc.end_year_end IS NOT NULL AND NOW() > cyc.end_year_end) ) THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'not_started' END AS evaluation_status, CASE WHEN ka.status_code = 407 AND UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM kaf.feedback_target_role_code)) = 'GM' THEN 'Chờ GM kiểm tra feedback' WHEN ka.status_code = 407 THEN 'Chờ PM kiểm tra feedback' WHEN ka.end_pm_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'Đã duyệt' WHEN (ka.mid_self_score IS NOT NULL OR ka.end_self_score IS NOT NULL OR (ka.evidences IS NOT NULL AND ka.evidences::text NOT IN ('{}', '[]', 'null'))) THEN 'Chờ duyệt' WHEN ka.status_code = 405 AND ( (cyc.mid_year_end IS NOT NULL AND NOW() > cyc.mid_year_end AND (cyc.end_year_start IS NULL OR NOW() < cyc.end_year_start)) OR (cyc.end_year_end IS NOT NULL AND NOW() > cyc.end_year_end) ) THEN 'Đã quá hạn tự đánh giá KPI' ELSE 'Chưa đánh giá' END AS evaluation_state, cat.id AS category_id, cat.name AS category_name, km.calculation_rule_code AS calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code AS calculation_type_code, st.code AS type_code, st.name AS type_name, km.unit_code AS unit_code FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpi_cycles cyc ON cyc.id = ka.cycle_id JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_categories cat ON km.category_id = cat.id AND cat.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_status_codes st ON km.type_code = st.code AND st.category = '${@com.company.kpi.common.constant.Constant@KPI_TYPE}'
AND st.name IN ('TEAM', #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND st.name = #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes sc ON ka.status_code = sc.code LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes unit_sc ON km.unit_code = unit_sc.code AND unit_sc.category = 'KPI_UNIT' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.feedback_note, UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) AS feedback_target_role_code FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = f.target_role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.assignment_id = ka.id AND f.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) kaf ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) AS created_by_role_code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = km.created_by ORDER BY CASE UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) creator_role ON TRUE WHERE ka.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cat.name, km.code

mapper.update: WITH source_assignment AS ( SELECT src.kpi_info_id, COALESCE(src.department_id, src_ud.department_id) AS resolved_department_id FROM kpi_assignments src JOIN kpis_information ki ON ki.id = src.kpi_info_id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments src_ud ON src_ud.user_id = src.user_id AND src_ud.is_primary = TRUE WHERE src.id = #{sourceAssignmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND src.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND src.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.type_code = 102 ) UPDATE kpi_assignments ka SET status_code = 503, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} FROM source_assignment src WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code = 502 AND ka.kpi_info_id = src.kpi_info_id AND COALESCE( ka.department_id, ( SELECT ka_ud.department_id FROM user_departments ka_ud WHERE ka_ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND ka_ud.is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1 ) ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.resolved_department_id

WITH source_assignment AS ( SELECT src.kpi_info_id, COALESCE(src.department_id, src_ud.department_id) AS resolved_department_id FROM kpi_assignments src JOIN kpis_information ki ON ki.id = src.kpi_info_id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments src_ud ON src_ud.user_id = src.user_id AND src_ud.is_primary = TRUE WHERE src.id = #{sourceAssignmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND src.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND src.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.type_code = 102 ) UPDATE kpi_assignments ka SET end_gm_score = #{endGmScore}, status_code = 603, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} FROM source_assignment src WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code = 602 AND ka.kpi_info_id = src.kpi_info_id AND COALESCE( ka.department_id, ( SELECT ka_ud.department_id FROM user_departments ka_ud WHERE ka_ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND ka_ud.is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1 ) ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.resolved_department_id

WITH touched_parent AS ( SELECT parent.id AS parent_id FROM kpi_assignments child INNER JOIN kpi_assignments parent ON parent.id = child.parent_assignment_id AND parent.cycle_id = child.cycle_id AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpis_information ki ON ki.id = parent.kpi_info_id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE child.id = #{childAssignmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND child.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND child.deleted_at IS NULL AND child.parent_assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.parent_assignment_id IS NULL AND parent.status_code = #{waitingStatus} AND km.type_code = 102 ) UPDATE kpi_assignments parent SET status_code = #{completedStatus}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} FROM touched_parent tp WHERE parent.id = tp.parent_id AND parent.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignments child WHERE child.parent_assignment_id = parent.id AND child.cycle_id = parent.cycle_id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignments child WHERE child.parent_assignment_id = parent.id AND child.cycle_id = parent.cycle_id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (#{completedStatus} = 503 AND child.status_code < 503) OR (#{completedStatus} = 603 AND child.status_code <> 603) ) )

UPDATE kpi_assignments SET evidences = jsonb_set( CASE WHEN evidences IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb WHEN jsonb_typeof(evidences) = 'object' THEN evidences ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, '{gmComment}', to_jsonb(COALESCE(#{gmComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '')::text), TRUE ), updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE id = #{assignmentId} AND cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND user_id = #{evaluationUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE kpi_assignments ka SET status_code = 404, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes sc_type ON sc_type.code = km.type_code AND sc_type.category = 'KPI_TYPE' WHERE ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.user_id = #{evaluationUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code NOT IN (401, 402, 403, 404, 407, 603) AND ( (#{promotion} = TRUE AND LOWER(COALESCE(sc_type.name, '')) LIKE '%promotion%') OR (#{promotion} = FALSE AND LOWER(COALESCE(sc_type.name, '')) NOT LIKE '%promotion%') )
mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.cycle_id AS cycle_id, ka.status_code AS status_code, asm.name AS status_name, asm.description AS status_description, ka.approval_user_id AS user_id, u.full_name AS user_full_name, u.username AS user_username, ( SELECT string_agg(TRIM(r.code), '|||' ORDER BY CASE UPPER(TRIM(r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code ) FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = ka.approval_user_id ) AS user_role_codes, ka.created_at AS requested_at, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, COALESCE(ka.target_value, ki.target_value) AS target_value, ki.target_description AS target_description, ki.weight AS weight, ki.is_important AS important, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code AS type_code, km.unit_code AS unit_code, ( SELECT f.feedback_note FROM kpi_assignment_feedbacks f INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = f.target_role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.assignment_id = ka.id AND f.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND f.is_active = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND UPPER(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.code)) = 'GM' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS feedback_note FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(ka.user_id, d.manager_id), ka.kpi_info_id) ka.id, ka.cycle_id, ka.kpi_info_id, ka.user_id, COALESCE(ka.user_id, d.manager_id) AS approval_user_id, ka.status_code, ka.target_value, ka.created_at, ka.parent_assignment_id FROM kpi_assignments ka LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = ka.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code = 403 AND COALESCE(ka.user_id, d.manager_id) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(ka.user_id, d.manager_id), ka.kpi_info_id, CASE WHEN ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ka.created_at DESC ) ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users u ON ka.approval_user_id = u.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes asm ON asm.code = ka.status_code AND asm.category = 'ASM_STATUS' WHERE ka.status_code = 403 ORDER BY CASE ka.status_code WHEN 403 THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, kc.name, km.code, u.full_name

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ka.id) ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.parent_assignment_id AS parent_assignment_id, ka.user_id AS user_id, km.id AS master_kpi_id, km.type_code AS type_code, km.name AS kpi_name, COALESCE(kas.user_full_name, member_u.full_name) AS member_name, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = member_u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS role_code, dept_mgr_u.full_name AS pm_name, COALESCE(kas.supervisor_full_name, leader_u.full_name) AS leader_name, COALESCE(kas.department_name, assign_dept.name) AS department_name, ka.status_code, CASE WHEN ka.evidences IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ka.evidences = '[]'::jsonb THEN NULL WHEN ka.evidences = '{}'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE ka.evidences::text END AS evidences FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users member_u ON ka.user_id = member_u.id AND member_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_snapshots kas ON kas.assignment_id = ka.id AND kas.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN users leader_u ON leader_u.id = ud.supervisor_id AND leader_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments prim_ud ON prim_ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND prim_ud.is_primary = TRUE
LEFT JOIN departments assign_dept ON assign_dept.id = COALESCE(kas.department_id, ka.department_id, prim_ud.department_id) AND assign_dept.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users dept_mgr_u ON dept_mgr_u.id = assign_dept.manager_id AND dept_mgr_u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.status_code BETWEEN 401 AND 603 ORDER BY ka.id

COALESCE(kas.user_full_name, member_u.full_name) AS member_name, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = member_u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS role_code, dept_mgr_u.full_name AS pm_name, COALESCE(kas.supervisor_full_name, leader_u.full_name) AS leader_name, COALESCE(kas.department_name, assign_dept.name) AS department_name, ka.status_code, CASE WHEN ka.evidences IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ka.evidences = '[]'::jsonb THEN NULL WHEN ka.evidences = '{}'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE ka.evidences::text END AS evidences FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users member_u ON ka.user_id = member_u.id AND member_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_snapshots kas ON kas.assignment_id = ka.id AND kas.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN users leader_u ON leader_u.id = ud.supervisor_id AND leader_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments prim_ud ON prim_ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND prim_ud.is_primary = TRUE INNER JOIN departments assign_dept ON assign_dept.id = COALESCE(kas.department_id, ka.department_id, prim_ud.department_id) AND assign_dept.deleted_at IS NULL AND assign_dept.manager_id = #{pmId, jdbcType=OTHER} LEFT JOIN users dept_mgr_u BETWEEN 401 AND 603 ORDER BY ka.id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ka.id) ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.parent_assignment_id AS parent_assignment_id, ka.user_id AS user_id, km.id AS master_kpi_id, km.type_code AS type_code, km.name AS kpi_name, COALESCE(kas.user_full_name, member_u.full_name) AS member_name, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = member_u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS role_code, dept_mgr_u.full_name AS pm_name, COALESCE(kas.supervisor_full_name, leader_u.full_name) AS leader_name, COALESCE(kas.department_name, assign_dept.name) AS department_name, ka.status_code, NULL::text AS evidences FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_cycles kc ON kc.id = ka.cycle_id JOIN users member_u ON ka.user_id = member_u.id AND member_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_snapshots kas ON kas.assignment_id = ka.id AND kas.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN users leader_u ON leader_u.id = ud.supervisor_id AND leader_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments prim_ud ON prim_ud.user_id = ka.user_id AND prim_ud.is_primary = TRUE
LEFT JOIN departments assign_dept ON assign_dept.id = COALESCE(kas.department_id, ka.department_id, prim_ud.department_id) AND assign_dept.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users dept_mgr_u ON dept_mgr_u.id = assign_dept.manager_id AND dept_mgr_u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.status_code IN
#{s}
AND ( CASE #{phase} WHEN 'mid' THEN NOW() BETWEEN kc.mid_year_start AND kc.mid_year_end WHEN 'yearEnd' THEN NOW() BETWEEN kc.end_year_start AND kc.end_year_end ELSE FALSE END ) ORDER BY ka.id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.id AS user_id, u.full_name AS full_name, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS role_code, d.name AS department_name, dept_mgr_u.full_name AS pm_name, leader_u.full_name AS leader_name FROM users u JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE JOIN departments d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users leader_u ON leader_u.id = ud.supervisor_id AND leader_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users dept_mgr_u ON dept_mgr_u.id = d.manager_id AND dept_mgr_u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND upper(r.code) IN ('MEMBER', 'LEADER', 'PM') WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignments ka WHERE ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code != 406 AND ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL ) ORDER BY u.id, d.id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.id AS user_id, u.full_name AS full_name, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS role_code, d.name AS department_name, dept_mgr_u.full_name AS pm_name, leader_u.full_name AS leader_name FROM users u JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE JOIN departments d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.manager_id = #{pmId, jdbcType=OTHER} LEFT JOIN users leader_u ON leader_u.id = ud.supervisor_id AND leader_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users dept_mgr_u ON dept_mgr_u.id = d.manager_id AND dept_mgr_u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND upper(r.code) IN ('MEMBER', 'LEADER', 'PM') WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignments ka WHERE ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.status_code != 406 AND ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL ) ORDER BY u.id, d.id

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM kpi_assignments parent JOIN kpis_information ki ON parent.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.type_code = 102 JOIN kpi_assignments child ON child.parent_assignment_id = parent.id AND child.cycle_id = parent.cycle_id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL AND child.user_id IS NOT NULL AND child.user_id <> #{pmId, jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE parent.user_id = #{pmId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND parent.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND parent.parent_assignment_id IS NULL AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(child.status_code, 0) NOT IN (#{waitingGmStatus}, #{completedStatus})

mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assign_id, ka.target_value AS assign_target_value, ka.mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.end_gm_score, NULL AS pm_comment, ka.status_code, ka.evidences, ki.id AS info_id, ki.target_description, ki.target_value, ki.weight, km.id AS master_id, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, km.type_code, km.calculation_rule_code, km.unit_code, unit_sc.name AS unit_name, kc.id AS category_id, kc.name AS category_name FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes unit_sc ON unit_sc.code = km.unit_code AND unit_sc.category = 'KPI_UNIT' WHERE ka.user_id = #{userId} AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL

WITH RECURSIVE org_edges AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (kas.user_id) kas.user_id, kas.supervisor_id, kas.department_id FROM kpi_assignment_snapshots kas INNER JOIN kpi_cycles kc ON kc.id = kas.cycle_id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL AND kc.year < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int WHERE kas.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND kas.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY kas.user_id, kas.created_at ASC ), fallback_edges AS ( SELECT ud.user_id, ud.supervisor_id, ud.department_id FROM user_departments ud WHERE ud.is_primary = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_edges oe WHERE oe.user_id = ud.user_id
